entities.name: Barrin Grevik
entities.description: A human merchant on Ravnica whose Tin Street shop marks a waypoint of the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and mind mage who questioned Barrin and erased his memory.

entities.name: Estovar
entities.description: Barrin's grand-uncle, who theorized the Azorius placed the cornerstone.

entities.name: Scrump
entities.description: Barrin's friend, blamed for drinking bumbat with him.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A maze with waypoints across Ravnica that Jace traced from Barrin's shop.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Guild thought to have placed the cornerstone after the original Guildpact.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: Guild Barrin suspected Jace of working for.

events.summary: Barrin sees Jace staring at the cornerstone of his shop; Jace uses mind magic to make him reveal all he knows.
events.quote: used mind magic on the merchant to make him tell Jace everything he knew about the cornerstone

events.summary: Barrin suspects Jace is a Dimir agent and follows him into a dark alley and basement.
events.quote: Barrin's theory was that Jace must be a Dimir agent

events.summary: Jace shows Barrin the Implicit Maze, reveals his identity, then erases Barrin's memories.
events.quote: he erased all of Barrins' memories of encountering him

events.summary: Barrin wakes with no memory of the encounter and swears off bumbat.
events.quote: He swore off drinking bumbat and went on with his day.
